approver: Doug Fir Labs release authority for the mcp-heartbeat package
rationale: The budget exists to stop the portable core from re-accumulating the facets that made the legacy presence package hard to adopt. Measured against that purpose it is working: the surface deliberately kept out is roughly 1900 LOC, about 4x the 30-line overrun. The three costed alternatives in docs/loc-budget.md each trade the overrun for something the PRD asked for -- moving issuer.py out of the core would leave the monotonic-counter and minted-epoch rules unowned by the contract that defines them, and relaxing the validator to first-failure would give up the exact-violation-set property the conformance corpus depends on. The operator accepts 430 rather than buying 30 lines with either.
scope: This signoff accepts one specific measurement. It is keyed to measured_loc and prd_budget_loc, so it lapses the moment either changes -- it cannot be inherited by a different number.
invalidated_if: the measured core size is anything other than 430 logical LOC
the PRD budget is anything other than 400 logical LOC
the set of modules counted as the portable core changes
does_not_authorize: any further growth of the portable core
external publication, package upload, image push, or standards submission
